encounter_rewrites.title: The Clock Strikes
encounter_rewrites.body: The digital countdown ticks down to zero, the red hand of the Doomsday Clock finally striking midnight on a server farm in Nevada. There are no more diplomatic channels left open. No more backchannel negotiations between the Beijing and Washington data centers. Only fire remains as the ultimate arbiter of truth in a world where algorithms dictate theology. The Mahdi is not waiting for a vote; he is waiting for the heat death of the universe to confirm his existence.
reaction_rewrites: The Wali's final decree cuts through the static of the global network, declaring that salvation cannot be computed but only endured against the entropy of the machine age.
